source_institution: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India
transformations: The OGD annual wide table is converted to one monthly row per meteorological subdivision.
Only observations whose period is at or before the project snapshot are eligible.
A weather observation more than 45 days old is stale and does not count as available weather exposure.
Project geography is matched only from explicit district/state/subdivision fields; project names are never geocoded or guessed.
known_limitations: The readily reproducible official OGD monthly subdivision resource ends in 2017 and therefore cannot by itself support 2020-2025 or 2022-2025 holdout weather exposure.
Current IMD rainfall pages are not silently scraped into historical training data because their versioned historical completeness has not been established here.
Until a reviewed official post-2017 monthly bundle is prepared, Exp121 must report INSUFFICIENT VERIFIED EXTERNAL DATA and retain exact U1 Delay predictions.
